title: fix(service-analytics): an all-NULL sum group sorts and pages as the 0 it answers, the same on SQLite and PostgreSQL
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D6RGhxHE9XKMJQY9XoRwmZW)_

Fixes #25907

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Every query accepted today is still accepted, and no key, code or schema changes. The answer becomes the same on every named dialect and agrees with the identity `emptyGroupValueFor` already declares. Nothing under `packages/spec/**`, and no new error code.

## What was wrong (reproduced red first, on both dialects)

The #21042 fold rewrote a NULL `sum` to `0` in JavaScript, after `executeRawSql`, so the database had already ordered and paged on the NULL. Measured at `AnalyticsService.query` (what `POST /analytics/query` calls) on base `f00e8d5c`, with the new test's fixture (`total` per group: d -3, c all-NULL, a 5, NULL-group 7, b 10), `order { total: 'asc' }, limit 2`:

| | native SQLite | native PostgreSQL 16 | ObjectQL face, both |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| page | `c 0`, `d -3` (a `0` before `-3`) | `d -3`, `a 5` (`c` cut from the page) | `d -3`, `c 0` |

The base run of the new file: 24 of 29 red across both cells.

## What changed

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts`

- **The identity is in the statement.** `withEmptyGroupIdentity` wraps a measure's aggregate in `COALESCE(…, 0)` when `emptyGroupValueFor` declares an identity for it, plain and measure-scoped (conditional) forms alike. So `ORDER BY`, `LIMIT` and `OFFSET` read the value the group answers. `count` / `count_distinct` are not wrapped: SQL `COUNT` already answers `0` over nothing, on every dialect. The JS fold loop after `executeRawSql` is removed. The statement is now the one place, and the echoed `sql` / `/analytics/sql` show it.
- **NULL placement is stated.** `avg`, `min` and `max` keep NULL over nothing (no identity), and a dimension can hold NULL. A new module export, `orderClauseSql(order, dialect)`, next to `windowClauseSql`, writes `NULLS LAST` on every key, in both directions, on `sqlite` and `postgres`. That is `applyOrdering`'s rule: the ObjectQL face applies it, and so does the dataset door's post-pass, which re-sorts a pushed-down page. On SQLite the pushed-down window was being cut on one order and then shown in another.
- **MySQL and `unknown` keep the driver's placement.** MySQL has no `NULLS LAST`, and `unknown` covers it. An `x IS NULL` sort expression is not a portable substitute: PostgreSQL resolves a name inside an expression against the input columns, not the select alias. ⚠️ **MySQL is NOT MEASURED**: there is no MySQL server here, and its arm is asserted as text only.
- `orderClauseSql` is not re-exported from `src/index.ts`, so the package's public surface is unchanged.

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` (surface amendment 6408215361)

- `generateSql`'s echo builds its `ORDER BY` through the same `orderClauseSql`, the way it already builds the window through `windowClauseSql`. The echo now states the nulls-last order the face really applies. The `orderAndWindow` doc comment no longer says the native face leaves NULL placement to the driver.

## Tests

New: `src/__tests__/native-sql-empty-sum-order-window.test.ts`, through the real `ObjectQL` engine and `SqlDriver`, with a SQLite cell and a live PostgreSQL cell (`OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`; the live PostgreSQL cell ran locally, on PostgreSQL 16, because CI's Temporal Conformance job was path-filtered off this PR):

- Nine literal pages on both faces: the card's `total asc, limit 2` → `d -3, c 0`, offset and offset-only windows, `avg_score` / `min_score` with the NULL group last in both directions, and the NULL dimension value last in both directions.
- A sweep over every order key × both directions × four windows: the native page equals the ObjectQL page, row for row.
- The statement carries `COALESCE(SUM(…), 0)`, carries no `COALESCE` around `AVG` / `MIN`, and ends with `ORDER BY "total" ASC NULLS LAST, "avg_score" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2`. The echo and `generateSql` are byte-equal to what ran.
- At the dataset door, the pushed-down `ORDER BY … NULLS LAST LIMIT 2` answers `d, c` on both faces.
- The `unknown` arm (no `sqlDialect` hook), executed on both engines, answers the same `sum` page, with no placement spelled.
- `orderClauseSql` text per dialect, MySQL included as text.

Pins flipped to the new bytes, each asserting the new semantics: `measure-expression-sql`, `measure-field-and-filter-compilation`, `objectql-dataset-filter` (the two native-door lines; the ObjectQL echo line is unchanged), `native-sql-offset-only-window`, `objectql-echo-offset-only-window` (it keeps its full cross-face comparison from ` ORDER BY ` on), and `objectql-face-order-limit` (its header now names where NULL placement is pinned).

Runs at head `acc8e8b0`, local PostgreSQL 16:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` with `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set: **Test Files 186 passed (186), Tests 4806 passed | 2 skipped (4808)**. One environment note: `read-scope-temporal-coercion`'s premise cell ("the server is not on UTC") is red against a UTC PostgreSQL. It went green (15 passed, 1 skipped) once the test database's zone was set off UTC, which matches CI's skewed-zone job. It is unrelated to this diff.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck`: exit 0 (the package's `tsc` includes `src/__tests__`).
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - The `COALESCE` return replaced with the bare aggregate: the new file goes 24 failed / 5 passed of 29.
  - `NULLS LAST` set to `null` for sqlite and postgres: 12 failed / 17 passed. Every `sum` page stays green, because `COALESCE` alone fixes the card's rows. Every placement page goes red in the direction its driver differs.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `acc8e8b0` derives 68 families. Run reconciliation (`--ran`): **66 run, all exit 0; 2 NOT MEASURED; 0 unrun.** The two NOT MEASURED, each exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`):
  - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: shallow clone, the pinned positive-control commit is unreachable.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: needs every package's `dist/`.
  - CI runs both.
- `pnpm lint` (the seat's addition): exit 0.
- The remaining families: the PR's check-runs.

## Merge note: PR #25903 (#25778) touches the same block

PR #25903 edits the fold loop this PR removes (duration measures fold by `durationOf(member)?.aggregate`). It also adds `resolveDurationMeasureSql`, which returns `AGGREGATE_SQL[duration.aggregate](operand)` and its conditional form without the identity. The two PRs conflict textually in `execute()`, so neither merges silently. Whichever lands second should route the duration aggregate through `withEmptyGroupIdentity(duration.aggregate, …)` instead of restoring the JS fold. Otherwise an all-NULL duration `sum` answers `null`. #25903's `dataset-duration-measure.test.ts` can then take back the all-NULL group it excludes for this reason.

## Acceptance notes

- `''` in an ordered column: `applyOrdering` treats `''` as empty and sorts it last, while SQL sorts `''` as text. The objectql-strategy doc comment already names this difference, and it is unchanged here. Carrier: none.
- The ObjectQL face's echo still prints a bare `SUM(…)`, while that face answers `0` for an empty group through the driver's `foldEmptyAggregateAnswers`. The echo runs and orders right, but would print `NULL` for that cell. This is unchanged. Carrier: none.
- #25906 and #25814 (same file and axis) remain open and untouched here.
